why: This is a named research software and accompanying preprocessed dataset release, already covered by the existing Open-source PyTorch DKT implementation product page.
name: Open-source PyTorch DKT implementation
product_description: An open-source implementation of Deep Knowledge Tracing with accompanying preprocessed student-interaction data, released by Chris Piech and colleagues for reproducing and extending their knowledge-tracing research.

why: The DKAS 2.0 is a named, validated assessment instrument used to measure dementia knowledge rather than a reusable instructional element.
name: Dementia Knowledge Assessment Scale 2.0 (DKAS 2.0)
product_description: A 25-item, expert-derived assessment developed to measure dementia knowledge about its characteristics, trajectory, risk factors, and care among carers, care workers, health professionals, and the general public.

why: The DKSCQ-N is a named, reusable questionnaire and measurement instrument rather than a general instructional element.
name: DKSCQ-N (Dysphagia Knowledge and Self-reported Competence Questionnaire for Nurses)
product_description: A 21-item, 11-point questionnaire developed by Mubeen Raffa et al. to assess hospital nurses' dysphagia knowledge and self-reported care competence across six domains.

why: This article reviews unresolved explanations of an empirical judgment bias and reports one study's finding, rather than proposing a general learning theory; its metacognitive account is only a possible mechanism related to Metacognition.

This is a study-specific psychometric mechanism explaining construct-irrelevant variance in formula-scored progress-test results, not a general theory of learning or a reusable education-specific research method.
